svg.title: Sharding in Modern Databases
svg.desc: Visual summary of how NoSQL and SQL databases handle sharding automatically
svg.text: Most managed — you just pick a key

g.text: "Use DynamoDB with user_id as partition key"
or "Shard with Vitess on user_id, plan for online resharding"
You specify the shard / partition key — the DB handles the rest

svg.text: Mechanics differ; abstraction level is the same for the developer
